steps.description: Install Service HP, create unique employee/product/transaction/image data, then install Salon using the same Google account and a different license.
Salon shows no Service HP employees, owner data, statistics, products, images, or backup contents.
Repeat the same-account isolation check pairwise across Kelontong, F&B, Laundry, Bengkel, Salon, Apotek, Fotocopy, and Service HP.
Every product has independent local/cloud data and product-scoped backup/image paths.
Create a backup for one product, clear its local data, reinstall the same product, and run cloud restore.
After a guaranteed reopen, restored employees, products, transactions, and images are present only in the matching product.
Attempt restore with a truncated/corrupt archive, then retry with a valid archive.
Failure is visible, old data remains intact, and the valid backup remains retryable.
Provide an archive containing ../, absolute, separator, unexpected, and oversized entry names.
Archive is rejected and no file outside the app documents directory is created or overwritten.
Try activation while offline, with revoked/expired keys, and after server-side revocation.
Local activation does not bypass required server state and revoked licenses cannot continue indefinitely.
Open /home, /kasir, /keuangan, /karyawan, /pengaturan, /laporan, and /cabang directly before activation, without login, and as each employee role.
Every route enforces activation, session, role, feature, and branch policy centrally.
Attempt login using active, inactive, terminated, wrong, repeated, NFC, and fingerprint credentials.
Inactive employees cannot log in; PIN verification is protected, rate-limited, and does not expose plaintext credential data.
Open Settings > Security with a valid session, stale session, wrong PIN, correct PIN, fingerprint, and NFC.
PIN pad opens before validation; stale sessions fall back correctly; wrong PIN is rejected and correct alternatives work.
Open Kelola Fitur on every variant from a fresh install and inspect all toggles.
Only applicable features are enabled/visible by default; irrelevant domain menus cannot leak into another product.
Drag every enabled feature to a different position, close Settings, restart the app, and open Home.
Home menu order exactly matches the saved order and remains product-scoped.
Select each preset, close/restart the app, and compare initial screen, Settings, and Home colors across all variants.
The saved palette is applied before first frame, labels are color-only, and preferences do not cross variants.
Place representative PNGs in every variant/theme/feature folder and run Home under each preset.
The correct PNG is loaded for variant/theme/feature, with a safe fallback only when an asset is missing.
Open Booking, navigate months, create/edit/cancel appointments, and create a conflicting appointment.
Booking controls work, data persists, conflicts validate, and counts/empty states reflect the database.
Create a service ticket, add customer/device/cost details, and transition it through statuses.
Ticket creation, status counts, edits, and persistence work without dead buttons.
Create laundry orders and move them through Baru, Cuci, Kering, Setrika, Siap, and Diambil.
Each stage is actionable and counts update from persisted records.
Configure table grid, tap tables, assign an order, occupy/free a table, and restart.
Table actions are not no-ops and table state persists correctly.
Create a prescription with doctor, patient, dosage, and batch information, then process it.
Prescription stats and statuses reflect stored records and validation prevents incomplete data.
Select each print service, configure pages/copies/paper/binding, create and complete an order.
Chips and Order Baru perform real actions and order totals/status persist.
Create Branch A/B transactions, expenses, employees, and stock; switch the branch picker and open dashboard/reports/finance.
Each branch view includes only permitted data and unassigned-user all-branch behavior is explicit.
Create a sale with stock, loyalty points, promo usage, and payment, then void it.
Stock movements, customer totals/points, promo usage, dashboard omzet, payment totals, and reports reverse consistently.
Submit concurrent checkouts/online orders for the same product and attempt a sale above available stock.
Updates are atomic, insufficient stock is rejected, and stock movement history reconciles exactly.
Finalize one stock-opname session twice and inspect product stock and movements.
Second finalization is rejected or no-op and differences are applied exactly once.
Record zero, negative, exact, partial, and overpayments while simulating an update failure.
Invalid amounts are rejected and debt/payment updates are atomic with no orphan rows.
Create normal and void sales at midnight, start/end boundaries, and adjacent dates; compare dashboard, transactions, reports, and finance.
All views use one date contract and exclude void rows consistently.
Call online-store and online_orders endpoints without auth and with another store_id; attempt read, insert, update, and delete.
Unauthenticated/cross-tenant operations are rejected and customer order data is not publicly enumerable.
Call license-manager with missing, guessed, and valid operator credentials; test every admin operation.
Only authenticated authorized operators can use service-role license operations and no static credential is accepted.
Upload same-named images for two accounts, products, employees, and settings categories, then sync and switch accounts.
Images remain isolated, no basename collisions occur, and sensitive images are not public.
Open concurrent cashier sessions and check in the same employee concurrently at midnight and normal time.
Only one valid active session and one employee/day attendance row exist; boundaries are correct.

title: Build artifact identity and failure cleanup

steps.description: Run the canonical builder with one simulated failed/timeout variant and inspect source config, Firebase file, output directory, and artifact metadata.
Original files are restored in finally, stale APKs are removed, failures stop publication, and every APK identity matches its variant.
